question: Prof M Yunus won the Nobel peace prize in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2006**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prof M Yunus** won the Nobel Peace Prize in **2006**.
 
• He is the founder of the **Grameen Bank**, which pioneered the concepts of microcredit and microfinance.
 
• His work has helped millions of people, especially women, escape poverty by providing small loans without requiring collateral.
 
• The Nobel Committee awarded him the prize for his efforts to create economic and social development from below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Grameen Bank** was established in **1983** and has since then provided financial services to the rural poor in Bangladesh.
 
• The concept of microcredit has been replicated in various countries across the world, showing a significant impact on global poverty alleviation.
 
• Prof Yunus has received numerous other awards and honors for his contributions to society.
 
• In addition to the Nobel Peace Prize, he has been awarded the **Presidential Medal of Freedom** and the **Congressional Gold Medal** in the United States.
